_note: 學習路徑內容建置第16批 #5／6：方式副詞子句 as if / as though（eng.t_adv.advcl.manner-as-if，學測級／高階）。as if 與 as though 同義（好像），引導方式子句。可能為真時用現在式（It looks as if it is going to rain.）；與事實相反的假設用過去式、be 動詞常用 were（He talks as if he knew everything. / She acts as if she were rich.）。誘答以『真實/非真實時態誤判／were 誤用 is／as if 與其他連接詞混用』鎖唯一正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix aif_）。

units.title_zh: 方式副詞子句（as if／as though）
units.can_do: 我能用 as if／as though 表達『好像…』：可能為真時用現在式（It looks as if it is going to rain.），與事實相反的假設用過去式、be 動詞常用 were（She acts as if she were rich.）。
units.situation_group: 方式副詞子句 as if / as though
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'as if' and 'as though' both mean 'in a way that suggests' and introduce a clause of manner; they are interchangeable.
claims.verification_ref: as if＝as though＝好像、引導方式子句、可互換；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: When what follows may well be true, a present tense is used: 'It looks as if it is going to rain.'
claims.verification_ref: 可能為真時用現在式；It looks as if it is going to rain；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: To describe something imagined or contrary to fact, a past tense is used: 'He talks as if he knew everything' (but he does not).
claims.verification_ref: 與事實相反用過去式；He talks as if he knew everything（其實不懂）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: In the unreal use, 'were' is commonly used for all persons after 'as if/as though': 'She acts as if she were rich.'
claims.verification_ref: 非真實用法 be 動詞各人稱常用 were；She acts as if she were rich；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: 'as if' and 'as though' have the same meaning. They describe how something looks or seems. When the thing may really be true, use the present tense: It looks as if it is going to rain. (It really might rain.)
teach.zh_hint: as if 和 as though 意思一樣，都是『好像…』，用來描述樣子或方式。如果說的事『可能是真的』，就用現在式：It looks as if it is going to rain.（看起來好像要下雨了——真的可能下。）

teach.body: It looks as if it is going to rain.
teach.zh_hint: 看起來好像要下雨了。可能為真，用現在式 is。

teach.body: When the idea is contrary to fact (not really true), use the past tense; for the verb 'be', we often use 'were' for every subject: He talks as if he knew everything. (He does not.) She acts as if she were a queen. (She is not.)
teach.zh_hint: 如果是『與事實相反』的假設（其實不是真的），就用過去式；be 動詞各人稱常用 were：He talks as if he knew everything.（他說話好像什麼都懂——其實不懂。）She acts as if she were a queen.（她表現得好像自己是女王——其實不是。）

teach.body: He talks as if he knew everything.
teach.zh_hint: 他說話好像什麼都懂。與事實相反，用過去式 knew。

teach.body: 'as though' can replace 'as if': You look as though you have seen a ghost. To choose the tense: use the present when the idea may be true, and the past when it is contrary to fact (with 'were' for the verb 'be').
teach.zh_hint: as though 可以和 as if 互換：You look as though you have seen a ghost.（你看起來好像見了鬼。）判斷用現在還是過去：這件事『有可能真』用現在式、『與事實相反』用過去式（be 動詞用 were）。

teach.body: She acts as if she were a queen.
teach.zh_hint: 她表現得好像自己是女王。與事實相反，be 動詞用 were。

practice.stem: 選正確：She acts as if she ____ a queen, but she is just an ordinary girl.（她表現得好像自己是女王，其實只是個普通女孩）

distractor_rationales.is: 句子明說『其實只是普通女孩』，是與事實相反的假設；標準／正式英語用假設語氣的過去式 were（口語偶爾聽到 is，但正式用法要用 were）。
distractor_rationales.will be: 這裡是與事實相反的假設，用假設語氣過去式 were；填 will be 會變成預測未來，不合此處語氣。
distractor_rationales.be: 需要有時態的動詞 were，不是原形 be。

practice.feedback: 與事實相反用 were：as if she were a queen。

practice.stem: 選正確：It looks as if it ____ going to rain soon.（看起來好像快要下雨了）

distractor_rationales.were: 這是『有可能成真』的描述，用現在式 is，不用與事實相反的過去式 were。
distractor_rationales.be: 需要有時態的動詞 is，不是原形 be。
distractor_rationales.will be: 這裡描述眼前跡象、用現在式 is（is going to rain 已表未來）；再加 will be 會與 going to 重複未來。

practice.feedback: 可能為真用現在式：It looks as if it is going to rain。

practice.stem: 'He speaks English as if he were a native speaker.' 這句的意思是？
practice.answer: 他英文說得好像母語人士（其實不是）
options: 他英文說得好像母語人士（其實不是）
他真的是英文母語人士
他想要成為英文母語人士

distractor_rationales.他真的是英文母語人士: as if＋were 表示與事實相反，他其實不是母語人士。
distractor_rationales.他想要成為英文母語人士: as if 是『好像』，不是『想要』。
distractor_rationales.他不會說英文: 他說得好像母語者，表示說得很好，不是不會。

practice.feedback: as if＋were＝好像…（其實不是）：好像母語人士但其實不是。

practice.stem: 選正確：You look ____ you have seen a ghost!（你看起來好像見了鬼！）

distractor_rationales.as long as: as long as 表條件『只要』，不是『好像』。
distractor_rationales.even if: even if 表讓步『即使』，不是『好像』。
distractor_rationales.so that: so that 表目的『以便』，不是『好像』。

practice.feedback: as though＝as if＝好像：look as though you have seen a ghost。

practice.stem: 選正確：He talks as if he ____ everything, but he often makes mistakes.（他說話好像什麼都懂，但他常犯錯）

distractor_rationales.knows: 句子明說『他常犯錯』，是與事實相反的假設；標準／正式英語用過去式 knew（口語偶爾用 knows，但正式用法要用 knew）。
distractor_rationales.will know: 句子明說他常犯錯，是與事實相反的假設，用過去式 knew；will know 是預測未來，不合此處語氣。
distractor_rationales.know: 主詞 he 需要過去式 knew（表與事實相反），不用原形 know。

practice.feedback: 與事實相反用過去式：as if he knew everything。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: He talks as if he knew everything.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：as if he knew（與事實相反用過去式 knew）有沒有寫對、句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。重音落在 as if／as though 後的關鍵詞、句尾下收。

lines.text: It looks as if it is going to rain.
lines.intonation: It looks as if 起、going to rain 句尾下收

lines.text: She acts as if she were a queen.
lines.intonation: She acts as if 起、she were a queen 句尾下收，重音在 queen
